PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$FILE" ]] && exit 0; [[ "$FILE" == *trading_signals* || "$FILE" == *migrated_customers* || "$FILE" == *.env || "$FILE" == *secrets* || "$FILE" == *secret_* ]] && echo "BLOCKED: $FILE is a protected data file" && exit 2; exit 0'

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$FILE" ]] && exit 0; [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]] && /usr/local/bin/python3 -m ruff format --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && /usr/local/bin/python3 -m ruff check --fix --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$FILE" ]] && exit 0; [[ "$FILE" == *.py && "$FILE" != *test_* && "$FILE" != *conftest* ]] && BASE=$(basename "$FILE" .py) && TEST=$(find tests/ -name "test_${BASE}.py" 2>/dev/null | head -1) && [[ -n "$TEST" ]] && /usr/local/bin/python3 -m pytest "$TEST" --tb=line -q --no-header 2>&1 | tail -3; exit 0'
